# Elliott Olson

> Personal website of Elliott Olson, a senior software engineer at Amazon AGI in Bellevue, Washington, who builds infrastructure for evaluating and serving foundation models.

## About

- Senior Software Development Engineer at Amazon (2026 to present); at Amazon since 2022, after Alexa internships in the summers of 2020 and 2021.
- Owns the inference architecture behind Amazon's central model evaluation platform, used by more than 130 scientists to launch the Nova family of models.
- Built the original internal application for testing in-development models, which became the foundation for the Nova consumer chat product.
- Previously led a latency program across six teams for Alexa's language understanding.
- Co-inventor on U.S. Patent 12,657,393, "Language Model Processing" (granted June 2026).
- Contributing author of "The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card".
- B.S. in Computer Science, Iowa State University (2017 to 2021).
